intro: Your room feels more complete with Raffin pouf. Use it as a seat, footrest, or side table, and enjoy a versatile accent that blends comfort, function, and warmth into your daily moments.

features.title: Multi-use design for daily ease
features.text: Switch roles effortlessly, extra seat when guests arrive, comfy footrest after a long day, or quick side table for snacks and books.

features.title: Cushioned comfort in every use
features.text: Padded filling keeps it soft yet supportive, so whether you sit, stretch your feet, or balance a tray, the pouf feels steady and pleasant.

features.title: Compact and easy to move
features.text: Lightweight design makes it simple to shift around the room, helping you change layouts or create flexible seating on the go.

features.title: Cinnamon tone that adds energy
features.text: The cinnamon finish brings a rich, warm accent to your space, making your room feel more vibrant while pairing easily with earthy palettes.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
